textos.texto: Ana lives in Arequipa, in Peru. There the weather is very good all the year. In the morning the sky is blue and there is a lot of sun. It is a warm day: twenty degrees. In winter it is cold at night, but in the day it is sunny. There is not any snow in the city, but there is snow on the mountains near it. From her window Ana can see three big mountains and the blue sky. In the summer months it is rainy and cloudy: there are many clouds and there is a storm in the afternoon. Ana does not go out when it rains. In her garden there are two trees and a lot of flowers. In the evening she can see the moon and the stars, because there is not any fog. Ana prefers Arequipa: it is not very hot and it is not very cold.

textos.texto: In Canada the weather is not the same all the year. In winter it is very cold: there is a lot of snow and ice on the road, and sometimes it is ten degrees under zero. The days are short and there is not much sun. In spring the snow goes and there are flowers in the parks. The weather is cool and it is often rainy and windy. In summer it is hot: twenty-five or thirty degrees. The sky is blue, there are not many clouds and the sun is very strong. Ana goes to the lake with Laura: near the lake there is a forest with big trees. In autumn it is cool again and there is a lot of wind. In the morning there is fog near the river. Laura prefers autumn, but Ana prefers summer: she is from Peru and she does not want the cold.

textos.texto: On Saturday Ana, Paul and Laura go to the beach. It is a hot day: twenty-eight degrees and there is a lot of sun. The sky is blue and there are not any clouds. The sea is cool, but it is not cold. On the beach there is a lot of wind in the afternoon, so Paul puts on his t-shirt. Near the beach there is a small forest with trees and flowers. Laura walks there, because the beach is very hot for her. At five there is a big cloud and the sky is not blue. Then it rains for twenty minutes: it is a small storm, with a lot of wind. The friends eat in a café near the sea and they are there for one hour. After the rain the sun comes back and the weather is warm again. At night they can see the moon and the stars on the sea.

textos.texto: On Tuesday morning the weather is not good. There is a lot of fog and the sky is grey. At nine there is a big storm: much rain and a lot of wind. The trees in the park go from left to right with the wind. Ana does not take her bike: she takes the metro, because on the road there is water and ice. It is very cold, two degrees. Paul is in his house all the day: he reads a book and he drinks a hot tea. In the evening the rain stops and there are not many clouds. One can see the moon and one star. On Wednesday the weather is very good: it is sunny and warm, fifteen degrees. Ana goes to the park with Laura and they walk near the river. There are flowers under the trees and the sky is blue again.

textos.texto: Marie lives near the sea, so the weather in her city is not very cold and not very hot. In summer it is a warm day: twenty-two or twenty-five degrees, the sky is blue and there are not many clouds. Marie goes to the beach with her sister and they walk near the water. In autumn it is cool and often windy. There is fog in the morning and the mountains are in the fog. In winter it is cold: five degrees, with a lot of rain and sometimes a storm. There is not any snow in her city, but there is snow and ice on the mountains. In spring there are flowers in the park and the trees are green. Marie prefers spring: the weather is warm and it is not rainy. At night she can see the moon and the stars from her window.
